name: Bích Động Pagoda
kicker: Cave pagoda in three halls up a limestone hill
summary: Cave pagoda in three halls up a limestone hill, 2 km from the pier and on the same ticket as the boat. Climb from the lower hall past the cave shrines to the upper hall, then look back over the river and the rice. Go the same day as the boat. Skip it if a hillside climb is hard for you.
fee: Included in the 250,000 VND Tam Cốc ticket
getThere: 2 km from the Tam Cốc pier by bicycle or shuttle
heroCaption: The pagoda gate across the lotus pond, with the limestone behind
body: The pagoda climbs the hill in three separate halls: chùa Hạ at the foot, chùa Trung against the cliff, and chùa Thượng near the top. Buddha statues stand in the dark caves between them. The lower hall has five bays on a high base, and its stone columns are single blocks over 4 m tall. Under the halls runs Xuyên Thủy, a water cave through the hill.

The name means green cave. The pagoda and the cave were first called Bích Sơn, and the monks Trí Kiên and Trí Thể built it up in the Lê Trung Hưng period. In 1774 lord Trịnh Sâm passed through, and Nguyễn Nghiễm oversaw eight months of work to carve the characters Bích Động into the rock, each frame 1.5 m tall. The old ranking calls it Nam thiên đệ nhị động, the second cave of the south.

During the war against the French the caves held the Phan Đình Phùng arms workshop, stored rice, and printed leaflets. A branch of the Ngô Đồng and the rice lie in front of the gate. Come after the boat, on the same ticket.

figures.caption: A hall of the pagoda under the cliff
figures.alt: A tiled pagoda hall among trees at the foot of a limestone cliff at Bích Động

gettingThere: Bích Động is 2 km from the Tam Cốc pier along the rice road. Ride a bicycle, or buy the 350,000 VND ticket that includes the electric shuttle between the stops.

legs.heading: From the Tam Cốc pier
legs.body: 2 km by bicycle or by the electric shuttle on the shuttle ticket.

admissionNote: On the Tam Cốc–Bích Động ticket: adult 250,000 VND, child 1–1.3 m 120,000 VND. With the electric shuttle: adult 350,000 VND, child 1–1.3 m 190,000 VND. No separate pagoda ticket is listed.
